items.name: Alertness Potion
items.description: Raises your Alertness Level by 1.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: Brew that neutralizes most poisons.

items.name: Assassin Elixir
items.description: Powerful concoction that temporarily increases your movement speed, stealth and coats your equipped melee weapon with poison.

items.name: Astral Potion
items.description: Potion which instantly restores some mana.

items.name: Barrier Potion
items.description: Grants Barrier.

items.name: Blessed Potion
items.description: Concoction that temporarily increases your Lightning Damage and Resistances.

items.name: Bracing Potion
items.description: Provides resistance to status effects for 60 seconds.

items.name: Cool Potion
items.description: Concoction that temporarily increases your Frost Damage and Resistances.  Starts the process of curing Meeka Fever.

items.name: Discipline Potion
items.description: Concoction that temporarily increases your Physical Damage.

items.name: Elemental Immunity Potion
items.description: Legendary brew that temporarily grants immunity to Fire, Frost, Lightning, Decay and Ethereal damage.

items.name: Elemental Resistance Potion
items.description: Powerful concoction that temporarily grants moderate resistance against Fire, Frost, Lightning, Decay and Ethereal damage.

items.name: Endurance Potion
items.description: Potion which instantly reinvigorates a tired body.  It restores a bit of max stamina.

items.name: Energizing Potion
items.description: Temporarily reduces skill cooldowns.

items.name: Gep's Drink
items.description: Brew that restores a moderate amount of health, stamina and mana

items.name: Golem Elixir
items.description: Powerful concoction that temporarily increases your weapon's Impact and gives you the Possessed and the Discipline boons.

items.name: Great Astral Potion
items.description: Concoction which instantly restores mana and max mana.

items.name: Great Endurance Potion
items.description: Concoction which instantly restores a massive amount of stamina and max stamina. It also grants Stamina Regeneration.

items.name: Great Life Potion
items.description:
Concoction which instantly restores health and max health.

It also closes Bleeding wounds.

items.name: Hex Cleaner
items.description: Strange brew that removes Hexes, Pain, Confusion, and starts the process of curing The Hunch disease.  Also increases the drinker’s protection against negative Status Effects.

items.name: Horror's Potion
items.description: Grants the drinker the Health Regeneration of a Shelled Horror.

items.name: Illuminating Potion
items.description: Grants the drinker the Mana Regeneration of an Illuminator.

items.name: Innocence Potion
items.description: Greatly increases resistance to Corruption.

items.name: Invigorating Potion
items.description: Heals the Sapped and Weaken Debuffs.

items.name: Krimp Nut
items.description: Edible nut that is a main ingredient in stamina-restoring elixirs.

items.name: Life Potion
items.description: Potion which instantly heals some wounds.

items.name: Mana Belly Potion
items.description: Grants Mana Regeneration, minor Protection, and reduced Mana Cost for a short duration.

items.name: Marathon Potion
items.description: Increases movement speed.

items.name: Mist Potion
items.description: Concoction that temporarily increases your Ethereal Damage and Resistances.

items.name: Panacea
items.description: A miraculous potion that cures all negative effects.

items.name: Peacemaker Elixir
items.description: Potion that grants permanent bonuses to the one who drinks it.

items.name: Possessed Potion
items.description: Concoction that temporarily increases your Decay Damage and Resistances.

items.name: Potions
items.description: Various magical potions.

items.name: Purity Potion
items.description: Substantially decreases Corruption.

items.name: Quartz Potion
items.description: Increases resistance to Corruption.

items.name: Rage Potion
items.description: Concoction that temporarily increases your Impact

items.name: Sanctifier Potion
items.description: Decreases Corruption.

items.name: Shimmer Potion
items.description: Grants Barrier, and 15% buff to elemental attack.

items.name: Spiked Alertness Potion
items.description: Raises your Alertness Level by 2.

items.name: Stability Potion
items.description: Concoction that increases your Impact Resistance.

items.name: Stealth Potion
items.description: Brew that temporary increases your stealth, making enemies less aware of your presence.

items.name: Stoneflesh Elixir
items.description: Powerful concoction that temporarily increases your Impact Resistance and the Physical Damage your attacks deal and grants the Rage Bonus.

items.name: Sulphur Potion
items.description: A bitter potion that offers greater strength, but reduces status resistance.

items.name: Survivor Elixir
items.description: Powerful concoction that restores stamina and burnt stamina, and provides protection from hot and freezing environments.

items.name: Warm Potion
items.description: Concoction that temporarily increases your Fire Damage and Resistances.

items.name: Warrior Elixir
items.description: Powerful concoction that temporarily increases the Physical damage and Impact your attacks deal and grants the Discipline boon.

items.name: Weather Defense Potion
items.description:
Concoction that provides relief from warm and cold temperatures.

Note that it has no effect on Fire and Frost damage.
